geojson_source: Natural Earth low resolution country outline of Russia; public domain Natural Earth data; extracted from local Natural Earth lowres fixture bundled with geospatial Python packages in the build environment.
region_reference_source: Embedded practical reference of Russian subjects and administrative centers used by previous program versions; editable/replacable through menu Геооснова.
note: Built-in outline is country-level, low-detail. Use menu Геооснова to download or load ADM1 subject-level GeoJSON for more accurate subject borders.
